title: Life in the Spirit, Heirs with Christ, Future Glory, God's Everlasting Love

questions.question: There is therefore now no ____ for those who are in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:1 (ESV): "There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus."

questions.question: For the law of the Spirit of life has set you free in Christ Jesus from the law of ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:2 (ESV): "For the law of the Spirit of life has set you free in Christ Jesus from the law of sin and death."

questions.question: For God has done what the law, weakened by the flesh, could not do. By sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned what?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:3 (ESV): "By sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,"

questions.question: For to set the mind on the flesh is death, but to set the mind on the Spirit is what?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:6 (ESV): "For to set the mind on the flesh is death, but to set the mind on the Spirit is life and peace."

questions.question: For the mind that is set on the flesh is ____ to God, for it does not submit to God's law; indeed, it cannot.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:7 (ESV): "For the mind that is set on the flesh is hostile to God, for it does not submit to God's law; indeed, it cannot."

questions.question: You, however, are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if in fact the Spirit of God dwells in you. Anyone who does not have the Spirit of Christ does not ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:9 (ESV): "You, however, are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if in fact the Spirit of God dwells in you. Anyone who does not have the Spirit of Christ does not belong to him."

questions.question: If the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:11 (ESV): "If the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you."

questions.question: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:14 (ESV): "For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God."

questions.question: For you did not receive the spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons, by whom we cry, ____!
questions.explanation: Romans 8:15 (ESV): "For you did not receive the spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons, by whom we cry, 'Abba! Father!'"

questions.question: The Spirit himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God, and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ, provided we do what?
options: Suffer with him in order that we may also be glorified with him
Walk in the light as he is in the light
Keep his commandments and abide in his love
Hold fast our confidence firm to the end
questions.correctAnswer: Suffer with him in order that we may also be glorified with him
questions.explanation: Romans 8:16-17 (ESV): "The Spirit himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God, and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ, provided we suffer with him in order that we may also be glorified with him."

questions.question: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing with the ____ that is to be revealed to us.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:18 (ESV): "For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing with the glory that is to be revealed to us."

questions.question: For the creation waits with eager longing for the revealing of the sons of God. For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of him who subjected it, in hope that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:19-21 (ESV): "...in hope that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to corruption and obtain the freedom of the glory of the children of God."

questions.question: Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:26 (ESV): "Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words."

questions.question: And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are ____.
options: chosen from the foundation of the world
questions.explanation: Romans 8:28 (ESV): "And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are called according to his purpose."

questions.question: For those whom he foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son. And those whom he predestined he also called, and those whom he called he also justified, and those whom he justified he also ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 8:29-30 (ESV): "And those whom he predestined he also called, and those whom he called he also justified, and those whom he justified he also glorified."

key_verse_text: And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are called according to his purpose.
